note: Provenance and screening record for every carrier. `inject` reads this file; benchmark/carriers/README.md is the human-readable form of the same facts. A replacement with a `type` is personal data and becomes a must_mask value; a replacement without one is an eponym -- a surname that has become the name of a device or technical term -- and becomes a must_clear value. Originals of the screened-out names are deliberately not recorded here. Licensing of the carrier text and of the cases derived from it: see benchmark/LICENSE-CARRIERS.md. Carrier ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: `inject` rotates the injection plan and derives each carrier's seed from its position in this list, so appending new carriers leaves every earlier carrier's cases byte-identical and reordering silently rewrites all of them. Append; do not reorder. `oldid` is the Wikimedia revision the text was taken from, recorded from carrier 55 onward so the snapshot is identifiable even after the live article moves on.
